name: thymio3-learn
description: Watch and steer the obstacle-avoidance learning of the Thymio 3: its little neural network, its weights, its sensors, live

scripts.test: node --test tests/ann.test.js tests/ai.test.js tests/brain.test.js tests/autonomous.test.js tests/reinforcement.test.js tests/share-ai.test.js tests/protocol.test.js tests/store.test.js tests/arena.test.js tests/chartkit.test.js tests/i18n.test.js tests/share.test.js tests/qr.test.js tests/names.test.js && node tests/link.test.js && python3 -I tests/test_ann_mode.py && python3 -I tests/test_ai_mode.py
scripts.golden: python3 -I tests/test_ann_mode.py --golden tests/golden-ann.json && python3 -I tests/test_ai_mode.py --golden tests/golden-ai.json
